    AI Overview
    For Sunday's final round of the 2026 Masters (April 12), live coverage begins with featured groups at 10:15 a.m. ET on streaming platforms, followed by early TV coverage on Paramount+ at 12 p.m. ET. The main CBS television broadcast for the final round runs from 2 p.m. to 7 p.m. ET. 
    Sunday, April 12 (Round 4) Schedule (All Times ET): 
    • Featured Groups: 10:15 a.m. – 7 p.m. (Paramount+, Masters App, ESPN App)
    • Amen Corner: 11:15 a.m. – 6 p.m. (Paramount+, Masters App)
    • Early Coverage: 12 p.m. – 2 p.m. (Paramount+)
    • Main Broadcast (TV):
      2 p.m. – 7 p.m. (CBS)
    • Final Round Streaming: 2 p.m. – 7 p.m. (Paramount+, CBSSports.com) 
    For the best experience, you can watch the final round on the Masters App or Paramount+.
